顾少卿的眸色瞬间冷厉了起来，带着浓郁的压迫力，周晓蜜被他这样的眼神给吓得身体止不住的朝后面缩了缩。
心胆寒，但是却在这个时候有种不得不硬着头皮上的感觉，所以周晓蜜将心底的害怕强压在心底。
周围的人听到周晓蜜的话，纷纷震惊了，没有想到被花家承认的顾家儿媳妇，居然私生活这么混乱吗？
所有人看向君雅思的眼神都变得不一样了，只是身为当事人的君雅思，却仍旧一点淡然，那模样像根本就不是在说她一样。
周晓蜜说着，就去自己的手包的里掏自己的手机，顾少卿薄唇微动，刚想要说话，君雅思就已经走上前来抓住了他的手臂按了按。
所有的人视线都落在君雅思的身上，不知道她是要做什么。所有的都是衣服看戏的表情，唯有花外婆与花小阳看着她的眼神是担忧的。
触及到他们二人担忧的眼神，君雅思的心里就像是被注入了一道温暖的光。
原本就不畏惧，但此刻她却觉得更温暖。
“周小姐，既然你能给的出我所谓的艳-照，如果是我，那么我愿意与顾少卿分手。”
听到君雅思的这话，周晓蜜心里瞬间燃起了希望，抬头看向君雅思。“你说真的？”
相对于她的欢喜，顾少卿则是眉头紧蹙，显然对君雅思的这话是不满的。
但碍于君雅思是为了处理周晓蜜，顾少卿这才没有多说什么，只是沉默着站在一旁。
尽管如此，他浑身上下散发出来的低气压那是在场所有的人都能够感受到的。
能在这里的人，都是带了脑子来的，就刚刚君雅思与顾少卿的那一一点点互动，就足以能说明她的事情并没有影响到顾少卿。
也就是说，这个周家女儿说的话，是不可信的。
想到这一点，所有人看着周志豪的眼神里都带着幸灾乐祸的味道，本来周家在这个圈子了的名声就不大好，这会儿要踢到铁板上了，他们自然是乐于见到的。
周志豪感受到那些不善的目光，一张老脸上更是感觉到火辣辣的疼，而这些都是因为他的这个混账女儿。
他低声斥吼，想要让周晓蜜听话不许在乱动，可周晓蜜会听他的话？这显然是不但可能的事情。
君雅思刚刚的那句话已经让她眼睛红了，此刻不管周志豪说什么，她都不会在听。
没有什么比嫁给顾少卿更让她心动了。
“就在这里。”说着，就已经点开了手机，将里面的画面给点开，放在了众人的面前。
所有的人都将自己的眼睛给蒙住，有的更甚至瞥向一旁，未来顾家的少奶奶，他们有几个胆子去看对方这样的照片？
周家不想活了，他们可是还有活下去。
瞧着这些人的动作，周晓蜜更是心里大急，怎么也没有想到他们会是这样的反应。
难道他们不该是看到上面的那些照片，纷纷斥责君雅思的吗？为什么跟她想的不一样？
“你们看看呀，这就是君雅思，一个放荡的女人，就这样的女人怎么能配得上顾少卿那样的男人？”

Chapter 1971 If you don’t believe me, I’ll show it to you (Page 1)
Gu Shaoqing's eyes instantly became cold and stern, with strong pressure. Zhou Xiaomi was so frightened by his eyes that she couldn't help but shrink back.
She was frightened, but she felt like she had to bite the bullet at this moment, so Zhou Xiaomi suppressed the fear in her heart.
The people around were shocked when they heard Zhou Xiaomi's words. Did they not expect that the daughter-in-law of the Gu family, who was recognized by the Hua family, would have such a messy private life?
Everyone looked at Jun Yasi differently, but as the person involved, Jun Yasi still looked indifferent, as if he was not talking about her at all.
Zhou Xiaomi said, and went to take out her mobile phone from her handbag. Gu Shaoqing's thin lips moved slightly. Just as he was about to speak, Jun Yasi stepped forward, grabbed his arm and pressed it.
Everyone's eyes fell on Jun Yasi, wondering what she was going to do. All of them looked like they were watching a show. Only Grandma Hua and Hua Xiaoyang looked at her with worried eyes.
Touching the worried eyes of the two of them, Jun Yasi's heart seemed to be injected with a warm light.
She wasn't afraid at first, but now she felt warmer.
"Miss Zhou, since you can give me so-called pornographic photos, if it were me, then I would be willing to break up with Gu Shaoqing."
Hearing Jun Yasi's words, Zhou Xiaomi's heart instantly ignited hope and she looked up at Jun Yasi. "Are you serious?"
Compared to her joy, Gu Shaoqing frowned, obviously dissatisfied with Jun Yasi's words.
But since Jun Yasi wanted to deal with Zhou Xiaomi, Gu Shaoqing didn't say anything and just stood aside in silence.
Despite this, the low pressure emanating from his body could be felt by everyone present.
People who can be here are all here with their brains. The little interaction between Jun Yasi and Gu Shaoqing just now is enough to show that her matter has not affected Gu Shaoqing.
In other words, what this daughter of the Zhou family said is not credible.
Thinking of this, everyone looked at Zhou Zhihao with a sense of schadenfreude in their eyes. The Zhou family's reputation in this circle was not very good, but now they were about to be kicked out of the iron, and they were naturally happy to see it.
Zhou Zhihao felt those unkind eyes, and his old face felt burning pain, and all of this was because of his bastard daughter.
He yelled in a low voice, trying to make Zhou Xiaomi obey and not move around, but would Zhou Xiaomi listen to him? This is obviously not only possible.
Jun Yasi's words just now made her eyes red. No matter what Zhou Zhihao said at this moment, she would not listen.
Nothing made her heart move more than marrying Gu Shaoqing.
"It's right here." After saying that, he already clicked on the phone, clicked on the picture inside, and placed it in front of everyone.
Everyone covered their eyes, and some even glanced aside. How many of the future young ladies of the Gu family have the guts to look at photos like this of each other?
The Zhou family doesn't want to live anymore, but they can still survive.
Looking at the actions of these people, Zhou Xiaomi felt even more anxious. She never expected that they would react like this.
Shouldn't they have seen the photos above and reprimanded Jun Yasi? Why is it different from what she thought?
"Look, this is Jun Yasi, a slutty woman. How can a woman like this be worthy of a man like Gu Shaoqing?"
